title: Inline Class

solutions.title: A plain string where the wrapper used to be
solutions.tradeoff: Losing the seam a future validation or parsing rule for catalogue keys could have grown into, and the small bit of type safety a dedicated key type gave for free.

reviewFocus: Does anything still construct the old key-wrapping class, anywhere - including a file this task did not touch?
Is matchesKey() a plain string comparison now, or does it still build an object just to compare it?
Was toString() actually unused before it was deleted, or did removing it change behaviour the tests failed to catch?
Compare against drill-07-05: name the one thing ContactDetails earned that the inlined class here never did.
